15 Vectors & Matrices Foundational [1 mark]
In the adjacent figure, line L1L_1L1​ is parallel to line L2L_2L2​. If the equation of line L1L_1L1​ is y=2x+3y = 2x + 3y=2x+3 and the equation of line L2L_2L2​ is y=mx+by = mx + by=mx+b, where mmm is the slope and bbb is the y-intercept, what is the value of mmm?
A. 12\frac{1}{2}21​
B. −2-2−2
C. 222 ✓
D. −12-\frac{1}{2}−21​
Correct Answer: (C) — 222
The property of parallel lines is that they have the same slope. The equation of line L1L_1L1​ is given in the form y=2x+3y = 2x + 3y=2x+3, which is in the slope-intercept form y=mx+by = mx + by=mx+b. By comparison, we find that the slope of line L1L_1L1​ is 2. Since line L2L_2L2​ is parallel to line L1L_1L1​, the slope of line L2L_2L2​, which is mmm, must be equal to the slope of line L1L_1L1​. Therefore, m=2m = 2m=2.

B. 30°30°30°

D. 60°60°60°
